tasks.title: Infrastructure: EnrollmentDbContext, EF config, repository, CourseArchived consumer, MassTransit outbox + DI
tasks.spec: Implement EnrollmentDbContext (DbSet<Enrollment>, schema 'enrollments') with global query filter on TenantId via injected ITenantContext (matches CourseService pattern). Configure entity per contracts.md section 2: table 'enrollments', partial unique index on (TenantId, UserId, CourseId) WHERE Status=Active, plus (TenantId, UserId, Status) and (TenantId, CourseId, Status) indexes; concurrency token via xmin (.IsRowVersion()). Implement EnrollmentRepository. Implement CourseArchivedConsumer (Infrastructure/Consumers): loads active enrolments for (TenantId, CourseId), sets Status=Suspended, SuspendedAt=now, SuspensionReason='course-archived'; idempotent via MassTransit inbox on EventId. Wire MassTransit with AddEntityFrameworkOutbox<EnrollmentDbContext> + RabbitMQ + UseMessageRetry intervals 1s,5s,30s. Provide AddEnrollmentInfrastructure(IConfiguration) DI extension consumed by Api and Migrator. NuGet: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore, Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL, MassTransit, MassTransit.RabbitMQ, MassTransit.EntityFrameworkCore.

tasks.spec: Generate EF Core migration named '20260427_001_InitialEnrollmentSchema' creating: schema 'enrollments'; table 'enrollments' with columns per contracts.md section 2; partial unique index on (TenantId, UserId, CourseId) WHERE Status=0 (Active); standard indexes (TenantId, UserId, Status) and (TenantId, CourseId, Status); MassTransit outbox/inbox tables (OutboxMessage, OutboxState, InboxState) in same schema. Wire Migrator Program.cs as IHostedService that calls Database.MigrateAsync() and exits 0 (matches CourseService.Migrator pattern). Use dotnet-ef-migrations skill. Migration is additive only — no data backfill needed.

tasks.title: Api layer: enrol/list/get/cancel/course-list/count endpoints, IsFree + duplicate gates, UserEnrolled + EnrollmentCancelled publishers
tasks.spec: Implement all endpoints per contracts.md section 5 with Minimal API endpoint groups under /api/enrollments. POST /api/enrollments: requires X-Roles to contain 'student' OR 'admin' OR 'org-admin' (any other role → 403; admin/org-admin = enrol-on-behalf bypass; UserId always sourced from X-User-Id header, never from request body); validates EnrollRequest (FluentValidation), enforces IsFree gate (409 PAYMENT_REQUIRED with extensions.code), enforces duplicate gate (409 ALREADY_ENROLLED) by checking active row for (TenantId, UserId, CourseId), inserts Enrollment with Status=Active and EnrolledAt=now, publishes UserEnrolled via outbox in same SaveChanges, returns 201 EnrollmentDto. GET /api/enrollments (paged; non-admin scoped to UserId from header). GET /{id} (404 cross-tenant). DELETE /{id} (owner-or-admin, 409 NOT_ACTIVE if not Active, sets Status=Cancelled + CancelledAt=now, publishes EnrollmentCancelled with new EventId). GET /courses/{courseId} (instructor/admin). GET /courses/{courseId}/count. HeaderTenantContext + TenantHeaderMiddleware reads X-User-Id, X-Tenant-Id, X-Roles (no JWT validation). ProblemDetails with extensions.code for PAYMENT_REQUIRED, ALREADY_ENROLLED, NOT_ACTIVE, TENANT_REQUIRED. Wire ServiceDefaults, AddEnrollmentInfrastructure, FeatureManagement, OpenTelemetry. Listen on port 5104.

Resource name MUST be 'enrollment' to match YARP cluster destination http://enrollment. Confirm in spec output that gateway appsettings.json already routes /api/enrollments/{**rest} → 'enrollment' cluster (no gateway change required).

tasks.title: Integration + unit + architecture + contract tests for EnrollmentService
tasks.spec: Per contracts.md section 8. Use xunit-integration skill: WebApplicationFactory + Testcontainers (Postgres + RabbitMQ) + MassTransit test harness. Tenant isolation pair on /api/enrollments/{id}. POST IsFree=true returns 201 + publishes UserEnrolled. POST IsFree=false → 409 PAYMENT_REQUIRED. Duplicate active enrol → 409 ALREADY_ENROLLED. Re-enrol after cancel succeeds. DELETE by owner → 204, status Cancelled, publishes EnrollmentCancelled. GET / scopes to caller for non-admin. Course-scoped count returns active+total. CourseArchivedConsumer suspends active enrolments and is idempotent on EventId (consume same message twice). Architecture: Enrollment inherits TenantEntity; EnrollmentDbContext applies global filter on TenantId. Contract: UserEnrolled has no EventId; EnrollmentCancelled shape stable.

tasks.title: Tenant isolation + auth + IsFree-gate audit
tasks.spec: Run tenant-isolation skill against EnrollmentService: (a) global EF query filter on TenantId is applied and not bypassed (.IgnoreQueryFilters() check); (b) no endpoint trusts a body-supplied TenantId — always sourced from X-Tenant-Id header; (c) cross-tenant lookups return 404 not 403 (leak-safe); (d) IsFree gate returns 409 PAYMENT_REQUIRED before any DB write; (e) duplicate-enrol gate cannot be raced (relies on partial unique index, not just app-level check); (f) authorization helpers correctly enforce owner-or-admin and instructor-or-admin; (g) CourseArchivedConsumer honours message TenantId and is idempotent on EventId; (h) no JWT validation downstream — only X-* headers; (i) no direct HTTP to CourseService — IsFree comes from request body only.
acceptance: audit report with zero high-severity findings
